checks: Request binds clip SHA and exactly two distinct chronological original moment IDs, frame SHA and presented times to validated sequence.
Sample dimensions are bounded and preserve common original raster aspect ratio; support is exact radius inset and sampler/brightness conventions are explicit.
The input reader verifies the complete original sequence PNGs through maintained admission before admitting the request; partial/failed reads release assets.
Sampling uses only admitted original frame URLs with declared full-frame canvas dimensions; abort checks retire replacement work. No derived categorical/physical inference is introduced.
Worker recomputes maintained finite comparison; app gates responses by revision, worker identity and exact source/settings equality.
Export revalidates original PNG hashes and serializes original sequence plus canonical request; comparison output is excluded and saved requests recompute on reopen.
Source/settings changes, cancel and page exit retire results and pending work; source replacements release old assets.
Previous cancel-during-loading wording finding corrected by branching on loaded.
Presenter uses textContent, labels sampled-pixel and shared RGB-offset units, retains all minima via maintained pagination, and exposes finite-comparison limitations.
